prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. TWO women standing side by side.

#1: THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, early 20s goddess, super hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum beyond any proportion, most dramatic hourglass ratio ever recorded on any human body, thighs so thick pressing together, long curly auburn hair
#1: Body Art: full body polished carnelian fused directly to her own form wrapping her whole body from the collarbones to the ankles, both legs carved all the way down to the ankles — this is solid stone curving to follow her body's true three-dimensional shape, divided into dozens of fitted stone sections, each joint standing in a thin raised ridge catching its own bright glint and casting its own small shadow, every section standing proud of the next. Dense fitted sections — BLAZING fiery orange-red carnelian surface across the full torso and both legs down to the ankles, VIVID pale golden-orange banding flowing through every section, with a carved geometric lattice relief across every section, high-gloss polished, completely opaque, with a deep three-dimensional carved surface. Her neck, from under the jaw down to the base of the neck, is bare real skin with visible pores and a soft natural sheen; the carved body starts exactly at the base of the neck, and her shoulders, chest, belly with its navel, arms, hands, wrists, legs and ankles are all carved carnelian.
#1: Cracks: the carnelian body shows weathering in only three places: one bold, clearly visible crack running across her left shoulder, and two chipped-off pieces, one at her left thigh and one at her left upper arm, where the broken edge reveals the dull raw pale orange-brown stone with a rough chalky surface, much duller than the polished outside inside. Everywhere else, including her bust, the carnelian is smooth, polished and whole, and her face, ears and neck are living skin.
#1: Pose: one hand trailing along her thigh, the other behind her back, hip tilted — most extreme super hourglass silhouette ever displayed.

#1: Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, coffin nails each as long as her whole hand, carved from the same carnelian with a high polish.
